newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn gains extended on acreage ideas, weather.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn gains extended on acreage ideas, weather.

text.p: CBOT corn futures gains were extended at midday on potential shifts from corn into soybean acreage in the U.S. Midwest, traders said.
Excessive wet weather in portions of the Midwest led to talk of potential cuts in corn acres in favor of soybean acres, they said.
A surge in soybean futures also boosted the market, the traders said.
Refco Inc bought 12.0 million bushels of corn with six million bushels purchased in the May and three million each in the July and December contract, traders said.
At 1240 CST, corn was 1-1/2 to 8-1/2 cents per bushel higher, with March up 8-1/2 at $3.09-1/4.
